verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs show mail can leave in open, standard forms. It supports standard IMAP/POP so other clients like Thunderbird sync messages and labels, the API supports read-only extraction/backup and account migration, and messages are RFC 2822 MIME. However, no first-party one-click full-account export is evidenced, and a community report says Gmail's own export tools fail on 100GB+ inboxes, forcing third-party tools. missing for 10: documented built-in full-account export, export of non-mail data (contacts, filters, settings) in open formats, reliable export at large mailbox sizes, independent hands-on corroboration of a successful exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Read-only mail extraction, indexing, and backup
You can add Gmail to other email clients, like Microsoft Outlook, Apple Mail, or Mozilla Thunderbird. When you add Gmail, your messages and labels are synced
The Gmail API requires MIME email messages compliant with RFC 2822 and encoded as base64URL strings.
